navaid.name: Carl E. Moses Boat Harbor (CEM)
navaid.description: The Carl E. Moses Boat Harbor (CEM) facility consists of 52 slips and 345 LF. Long-term slips and transient moorage spaces are available for vessels up to 150 feet.

navaid.name: Robert Storrs Small Boat Harbor
navaid.description: The Robert Storrs Small Boat Harbor consists of 1,232 linear feet of floats, comprising 71 slips. Long-term slips and transient moorage spaces are available for vessels up to 60 feet. Potable water, shore-power, and refuse removal are available.
